data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Support & Integration (C++) – Digital Patient Model
data.description:
What you'll do

As a Senior Software Engineer, Support & Integration (C++), you will join the Snke Anatomy Applications team and help ensure that our Digital Patient Model services are reliably integrated and supported in customer environments. In this role, you will handle escalated technical issues and provide third-level support through analysis, root cause investigation, and collaboration with the engineering team. You will also support legacy products through technical analysis and contribute to development work whenever support demand allows.

  • Investigate and analyze customer-reported issues in production systems, integration setups, and internal environments.
  • Reproduce issues, identify root causes, and provide clear technical findings to the responsible engineering team.
  • Support customers with the integration of our services, APIs, and data flows.
  • Analyze issues in legacy products and support their continued operation.
  • Work with modern C++20 services and understand older C++ code bases for debugging and support purposes.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to internal teams and customers.
  • Contribute to development work when support priorities allow.


What we're looking for

data.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer — Mobile Healthcare Platform
data.description:
What you'll do

We are a startup building a platform that is in daily use during patient care, and our direction changes as we learn. The engineer we are looking for is comfortable with that: someone who moves between backend, mobile, integration and platform work as the product demands, and who picks up new technologies quickly because their strength is in engineering fundamentals rather than any one stack.
Right now that means, among other things, bringing our clinical mobile app to Android, evolving how our product integrates with hospital systems, and keeping our services dependable across cloud and on-premise deployments. Six months from now the list will look different, and you will help decide what is on it.
We build AI-native: agents write a large share of our code, and the engineer's job is to design the system, specify the work precisely, and keep the codebase in a state where both humans and AI tools can understand and extend it safely. Your engineering judgement is the product here.

  • Move across the stack as priorities shift: mobile UI, backend services, APIs, hospital integrations, platform and deployment work
  • Own the architecture of the parts you touch: module boundaries, API contracts, data models, and the decisions behind them
  • Direct AI coding agents to implement against your specifications, and review their output with the same rigour you would apply to a colleague's pull request

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 25 High-Performern hat innerhalb von 2 Jahren ein konstantes Monatswachstum von über 750.000 € aufgebaut. Was für dich drin ist:

data.title: Senior Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Schwerpunkt Performance Marketing
data.description:
Über uns

Bei uns musst Du Dich nicht zwischen Kreativität und harten Zahlen entscheiden - wir brauchen beides. Und jemanden, der sein Wissen gerne weitergibt.
Als Senior Marketing Manager (m/w/d) entwickelst Du Themen, Kampagnen und Formate von der ersten Idee bis zur Auswertung: Lead-Magnete und Funnel, Webinar-Reihen und Fachveranstaltungen, Kampagnen über SEA, LinkedIn und Newsletter, die aktiv ineinandergreifen statt nebeneinanderher zu laufen. Was Du dabei nie aus dem Blick verlierst: die Zahlen dahinter. Du sorgst dafür, dass am Ende messbar ist, was davon wirkt und was nicht - und leitest entsprechende Maßnahmen ab. Dein Ziel: avenit als starke Marke zu positionieren und sicherzustellen, dass unser Vertrieb verlässlich mit qualifizierten Leads versorgt wird. Den Weg dorthin gestaltest Du selbst. Zusätzlich begleitest Du unser Digital Marketing Team bei Kundenprojekten als fachlicher Sparringspartner, indem Du Dein Know-how und Erfahrungen teilst und dem Team so hilfst, sich weiterzuentwickeln.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Marktpositionierung & Value Proposition Du positionierst unsere Digitalagentur strategisch am Markt, entwickelst zielgruppengerechte Value Propositions und unterstützt aktiv bei der Markteinführung neuer Produkte und Leistungen. Du arbeitest eng mit allen Bereichen und dem Vertrieb zusammen, um die Customer Journey gezielt zu begleiten.
